creator.biography: Hi I'm Danielle and I am an equine physical therapist based in the UK.  I have been living my best life as an equine therapist since 2009 and I LOVE my work.  I use a range of different modalities including sports massage, trigger point therapy, Masterson Method and myofascial release for injury prevention, injury rehabilitation and to work towards optimum performance.  I am lucky enough to work on a wide range of horses from adored leisure horses and treasured golden oldies to performance horses working at the highest levels and I learn from each and every one of them - every day's a school day!  I hope you enjoy browsing my videos and I would love to hear from you either here or at my FB page - just search danielle equine sports massage.  Enjoy! X.

candidates.name: Pivot Point Performance
candidates.summary: 频道简介自称“Pivot Point Performance is a horse-and-rider wellness company”，并自称“combining physical therapy, assisted stretching, rider evaluations, and equine bodywork”，明确指向马匹物理治疗方向。

creator.biography:
Pivot Point Performance is a horse-and-rider wellness company dedicated to helping both ends of the partnership move, feel, and perform at their best.

We specialize in a whole-body, whole-system approach—combining physical therapy, assisted stretching, rider evaluations, and equine bodywork to identify and address the root causes of pain, restriction, or performance limitations.

Whether you’re a competitive athlete, weekend rider, or simply want you and your horse to feel better, our goal is to create better communication, improved movement, and longer-lasting soundness for both horse and rider.

Through hands-on sessions, customized programs, and educational clinics, we don’t just treat symptoms—we give you the tools and understanding to take control of your progress.

Because when both horse and rider move better… everything changes.

Hi there! I'm Maija, the founder of Freely Forward Bodywork. As an equine massage therapist, my focus is on enabling your horses’ comfort and performance through the use of massage therapy and stretching techniques. I aim to work with you and enable your horse to perform to its full potential, by analysing and assessing posture, movement, and skeletal function.

From providing a range of services to forming a treatment plan that is an integral part of my approach to treating the whole body, to offering online courses where you can learn effective techniques on how to treat your horse yourself, Freely Forward Bodywork is your go-to hub for equine wellness and performance.

Check out our brand new podcast, NO BUCKS GIVEN, where we have honest conversations about the horse industry with industry professionals about the hard truths around what matters most, how to best advocate for our horses. Subscribe here or anywhere you get podcasts!

Welcome to 𝗛𝗼𝗿𝘀𝗲𝘀 𝗜𝗻𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲 𝗢𝘂𝘁 — our aim is to help you understand your horse like never before.

This channel will give you fascinating anatomy insights and practical training advice that will help you:
- Improve your horse’s performance
- Train with empathy and understanding
- Boost overall well-being
- Minimise the risk of injury

Take a deeper look inside the horse. Once you see how beautifully and intricately the skeleton moves, you’ll never look at riding the same way again. We make it fun to learn about the anatomy, biomechanics and conditioning of the horse to improve performance, train sympathetically, enhance well being and reduce the risk of injury.

creator.biography:
Hi 👋 i'm Cat Dachtler i have been an Equine Sports massage therapist and rehabilitation specialist over 20 yrs & over 30yrs as a professional handler, rider, instructor, competitor

As a Rehabilitation specialist i focused on foundation training & remedial therapy, relaxation is key when restarting or starting any horse & something many trainers miss 

I qualified as an Equine Sports Masseuse under Mary Bromiley MBE in 1995 and 1998 for sports massage therapist for people / riders.
I used to help horses all over the UK, give clinics and host workshops i’m also a qualified group fitness coach and deliver Rider Fitness 

Now owners learn to build a better relationship with their horses & get their desired out comes with me online 

my website www.back-in-the-saddle.co.uk is now closed as i rebuild from ground zero after chronic illness put me on my bum bum

You tell me why you and your horse would benefit from having a better relationship

candidates.summary: 频道简介自称提供 SURE FOOT Equine Stability Program，帮助马匹改善平衡、放松、本体感觉与表现，并支持康复，对应马匹治疗方向。

creator.biography:
SURE FOOT Equine Stability Program® | Horse Balance, Relaxation & Performance

The SURE FOOT Equine Stability Program® helps horses improve balance, relaxation, proprioception, and performance using SURE FOOT Pads.

On this channel, you’ll learn how to support your horse’s posture, movement, confidence, and long-term soundness—whether for training, rehabilitation, or everyday handling.

SURE FOOT Pads give horses the opportunity to explore their own balance. As they become more aware of how they are organized over their feet, many horses show reduced tension, improved movement, and greater comfort.

Wendy Murdoch, creator of SURE FOOT, shares how to:

Introduce pads safely
Choose the right pad types
Read your horse’s responses
Improve balance and body awareness
Support rehab, performance, and behavior

Used by horse owners, trainers, veterinarians, bodyworkers, and farriers, SURE FOOT helps horses become more relaxed, balanced, and confident.

candidates.summary: 频道简介自称是非营利501c3组织，采用 EAGALA 模式提供马辅助心理治疗（EAP）与马辅助学习（EAL），并说明不提供骑乘活动。

creator.biography:
Spring Reins of Life  (SRoL) / Horses, Humans & Healing!
Spring Reins of Life is a non-profit 501c3 organization.  We are an EAGALA (Equine Assisted Growth and Learning Association) model program offering Equine Assisted Psychotherapy (EAP) and Equine Assisted Learning (EAL) which incorporates the use of horses for therapeutic intervention toward promoting emotional growth and healing.  Our program is a team approach featuring a licensed Mental Health Professional (MHP), a certified Equine Specialist (ES), and Horse(s) specifically selected for their capacity to work with individuals who are troubled or suffering.  We do not offer any riding or mounted activities in our program. candidates.summary: 频道简介自称“WETRA is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with physical, mental, and emotional challenges through equine related therapy”，并自称“Therapeutic riding is an alternative form of therapy using horses”，明确指向马辅助治疗（服务人）方向。

creator.biography:
WETRA is committed to improving the quality of life of persons with physical, mental, and emotional challenges through equine related therapy.

Therapeutic riding is an alternative form of therapy using horses to help persons with various disabilities.  Activities involving the horse can be used to assist people with disabilities in achieving physical and mental health, and cognitive, behavioral, social and communication goals.  

WETRA raises revenue by holding various fundraisers, rider fees, writing grants, and donations from the community. It is through endless fundraising efforts that WETRA is able to keep the cost of riding sessions to a minimum. Donations are required to purchase tack, horses and program related equipment.  Also, to maintain and feed horses, and repair and improve buildings. Thank you for supporting a truly unique program.

candidates.summary: 频道简介自称“Beachwood Integrative Equine Therapy offers private healing intensives that support anxiety, stress, trauma, and major life transitions”，并自称“This channel shares insights from Integrative Equine Therapists”，明确指向马辅助治疗（服务人）方向。

creator.biography:
Beachwood Integrative Equine Therapy offers private healing intensives that support anxiety, stress, trauma, and major life transitions through a whole-person, nervous-system–based approach.

Beachwood specializes in Integrative Equine Therapy (IET)—a guided, experiential modality that works through the horse–human connection to support regulation, clarity, and meaningful change. This work is relationship-based, intentionally private, and carefully facilitated.

Beachwood serves adults, professionals, and families through private intensives only (never groups) at centers in Rhode Island, Maryland, Pennsylvania, Florida, and California.

This channel shares insights from Integrative Equine Therapists and observations from working alongside horses, offering a grounded perspective on nervous-system health and whole-person healing.

Learn more at https://beachwoodri.org/intensives

London College of Animal Osteopathy (LCAO) offers world-class online training in animal osteopathy, designed for veterinarians, equine professionals, canine therapists, osteopaths, and animal care practitioners looking to advance their clinical skills and career.

Our International Diploma in Animal Osteopathy provides comprehensive training in both equine osteopathy and canine osteopathy, combining evidence-based theory with practical application for real-world clinical outcomes.

Delivered through a flexible, self-paced online format, our programs allow you to study from anywhere in the world, with optional hands-on clinical training (MasterClass) available in select global locations.

Students learn under the guidance of Prof. Stuart McGregor, Director of Clinical Studies, alongside an expert international faculty.

 Start your journey in animal osteopathy today: www.animalosteopathycollege.com

🏇 Welcome to Horse Heaven Equestrian Sports Club🏇
Where Tradition Meets Excellence in Equestrian Training

Step into a world where the legacy of horsemanship lives on! 
At Horse Heaven Equestrian Sports Club, we uphold the centuries-old bond between humans and horses, inspired by the majestic history of equestrian arts across cultures.

From the ancient cavalry of empires to the refined discipline of classical dressage, horsemanship has always symbolized grace, strength, and trust. Our Club continues this proud tradition by training both horse and rider in disciplines like:

✨ Joy Riding
✨ Basic Riding
✨ Show Jumping
✨ Dressage
✨ Eventing
✨ Endurance Riding
✨ Polo
✨ Jungle Safari
✨ Horse Stabling Facility

creator.biography:
Distance and blended learning courses.

The Open College of Equine Studies (TOCES) specialises in equine management, equine science and equine veterinary nursing distance and blended learning courses. TOCES learners are based all over the world and their ages range from 16 to 69!

Based in England, TOCES is an independent international distance learning college specialising in equine study programmes. Learners all over the world are able to study and learn via printed and online course materials. Some programmes include study weeks during which course notes are supplemented with lectures from subject experts. Practical skills are taught and assessed.

General Equine Programmes: www.equinestudies.co.uk

Equine Veterinary Nursing Programmes: https://www.equinestudies.co.uk/veterinary-nursing/

creator.biography: Northern Michigan Equine Therapy is a 501(c)(3) non-profit outpatient rehabilitation facility dedicated to equine assisted therapy using the healing nature of a horse as a therapeutic tool to enhance independence, self-confidence, and quality of life of our clients. With the natural movement and demeanor of a horse we help those with physical, emotional, and/or mental health needs. NMET is a support system to the community. With a horse’s guidance and support, our Occupational Therapy (Hippotherapy), HorseSense® Self Development, and At-Risk Youth programs are offered by licensed professionals and equine specialists to provide the community with the best quality of service to those in need. Our purpose is to assist and strengthen what is needed for a more fulfilling and independent life. The mission of NMET is to harness the healing powers of horses to improve lives.

candidates.summary: 频道简介自称提供马辅助治疗和马辅助学习，服务儿童、青少年和成人，属于马辅助治疗（服务人）方向。

creator.biography:
The Horse's Heartbeat offers Equine Assisted Therapy and Equine Assisted Learning for individuals and groups in Little River, Victoria (located within easy access of Geelong and Melbourne). 
Our learning, counselling and psychotherapy sessions are beneficial for children, adolescents and adults. We support clients in areas including anxiety, depression, trauma, emotional dysregulation and mental wellbeing. We offer innovative and experiential programs to support clients to become aware, relaxed, and able to step into their best life. 
We have a herd of six horses - two miniature ponies and four 'big' horses. The Horse's Heartbeat equine herd are valued and their welfare is at the core of all of our work. Our horses are treated ethically, kindly and are free to express their boundaries, even while engaging in their therapy and learning work with clients. Through this, we know that the connections and relationships between horse and human truly reflect a genuine, unforced interaction.

our learning, counselling and psychotherapy sessions are beneficial for children, adolescents and adults. we support clients in areas including anxiety, depression, trauma, emotional dysregulation and mental wellbeing. we offer innovative and experiential programs to support clients to become aware, relaxed, and able to step into their best life. 
we have a herd of six horses - two miniature ponies and four 'big' horses. the horse's heartbeat equine herd are valued and their welfare is at the core of all of our work. our horses are treated ethically, kindly and are free to express their boundaries, even while engaging in their therapy and learning work with clients. through this, we know that the connections and relationships between horse and human truly reflect a genuine, unforced interaction. australia human_therapy https://www.youtube.com/channel/ucykxinq9x-xbks98j2aeupq 马辅助治疗（服务人） 职业与培训路径 频道简介自称提供马辅助治疗和马辅助学习，服务儿童、青少年和成人，属于马辅助治疗（服务人）方向。 视频标题提到“qualifications, certifications and experience - equine assisted therapy and equine assisted learning”，涉及资质与培训路径。 视频标题提到“what is equine assisted therapy?”，直接涉及马辅助治疗主题。

creator.biography:
Welcome to Rajaswa Horse Riding Club!
Your ultimate destination for comprehensive and informative horse training videos, dedicated to the art, discipline, and thrill of equestrian sports.

🐴 What We Offer:

Dive into our expert training sessions and tutorials covering a wide range of equestrian activities and games:

 * Jumping
 * Dressage
 * Tent Pegging
 * Pole Bending
 * And many more exciting games and competitive events!

👨‍🏫 Expert Guidance & Legacy:

All training is conducted under the esteemed guidance of our chief instructor, Rajeev Kanade Sir. Rajaswa Horse Riding Club has been nurturing equestrian talent and maintaining a tradition of excellence in Ahilyanagar since 2017.

🐎 Our Magnificent Breeds:

Meet the stars of our stable! We feature and train magnificent Indian horse breeds, including the noble Marwari, the spirited Kathiyawadi

Subscribe now to start your riding journey, master the art of horsemanship, and become part of the Rajaswa Horse Riding Club family!

candidates.name: Serendipity Ranch Equine Assisted ACT Therapy
candidates.summary: 频道简介自称面向马辅助学习从业者及想成为从业者的人，涉及Acceptance and Commitment Therapy、马术技能与个人成长。

creator.biography:
New Ways of Seeing Equine Assisted Learning
This online platform is for practitioners working in the field of Equine Assisted Learning, for people who would like to become practitioners, or even for people who have horses and love personal
growth, leadership and horsemanship.
This is for people who care for the horses as much as they care for clients.

Acceptance and Commitment Therapy, Emotional Intelligence, Positive Psychology. Polyvagal Theory etc.
– to create unique and meaningful workshops
– add value to horses and clients
– become successful in life and business
– define your own path for yourself and clients
– be a leader horses and people love to follow

The new knowledge will help you to:
– be inspired to improve your horsemanship skills
– be confident and an inspiration for others
– grow as a person, as a friend, as a leader
– be confident, clear, enthusiastic and credible

creator.biography:
International Horse College (Ausintec Academy) was born out of a need to improve safety in the horse industry while
considering the welfare of horses.
Motto
People Safety and Horse Welfare
 
Mission
To improve the welfare of horses around the world through the safe education of their riders, handlers and trainers.
 
Vision
To have a world where people safely appreciate, respect and enjoy their horses and the horses appreciate, respect and enjoy their people.
 
Values
Horse Welfare and Safety are of utmost importance when humans have any interaction with horses.
Within our courses, we only utilize methods that promote safe and humane methods of interaction between horses and humans.
We only support safe methods of educating riders, handlers and trainers about horse welfare.
 
History
Ausintec/ Caboolture Equestrian Centre became a Registered Training Organisation (CRICOS Registered) in 2001
and for many years was a regular home and training centre to International and Australian student

We partner with horses for much of this work and incorporate them in this channel as well.

candidates.summary: 频道简介自称提供“Integrated Equine Performance Bodywork”，是一种马匹按摩和身体工作方法，属于马匹治疗师（服务马匹）方向。

creator.biography: The Masterson Method - Integrated Equine Performance Bodywork, is a unique, interactive method of equine massage and bodywork in which you learn to recognize and use the responses of the horse to your touch to find and release accumulated tension in key junctions of the body that most affect performance. In contrast to most traditional modalities, it enables the horse to actively participate in the process of releasing tension. It is something you do with the horse, rather than to the horse. This participation and interaction is what makes the method fascinating for those who use it. In fact, if you do not allow the horse to participate, it does not work!

candidates.summary: 频道简介自称是面向青少年的住宿治疗中心，采用“equine-assisted psychotherapy”并结合创伤知情治疗，明确属于马辅助治疗（服务人）方向。

creator.biography:
Uinta Academy is a residential treatment center serving youth assigned female at birth ages 13–21 who struggle with attachment issues, mood disorders, maintaining interpersonal relationships, and/or healing after trauma. 

Uinta’s unique blend of equine-assisted psychotherapy, trauma-informed therapy, research-based therapeutic milieu, and accredited academics promote long-lasting change. Our team of highly skilled and licensed professionals provides individual, family, and group therapy to ensure a personalized and supportive experience. 

Our equine program sets us apart. Horses possess incredible qualities that make them exceptional partners in the healing process. Just like humans, horses are herd animals with a social order. At Uinta, students learn to build trusting relationships with horses. The way they manages this process often mirrors their interactions with others, providing valuable insights and growth opportunities.

Join us in support of their healing journey at Uinta.

creator.biography:
Equi-Ice Is the simplest and most effective ice pack/ cold therapy product designed specifically for horses that provides direct delivery of ice to targeted areas. Equi-Ice is a durable and re-useable ice pack that delivers immediate benefits of direct icing to the horse’s spine and back muscles. Created by leading Australian equine physiotherapist, Tom Simpson (physiotom.com.au), Equi-Ice can be used routinely by horse owners to promote faster recovery post-exercise or injury.
Further information is available at www.equi-ice.com.au.  From Australia, call 1300  755 516. Email inquiries to info@equi-ice.com.au.

creator.biography:
We are a portable equine therapy program. We visit Hospital campuses across Central Florida every week. We also provide k-12 schools and colleges. In addition to inpatient behavioral and mental health campuses. 
     The benefits of equine therapy are well known. We quickly realized the immeasurable need for this amazing service in our community. Especially in the healthcare/clinical setting as it relates to mental health. Equine therapy is effective alongside a variety of medical and psychological conditions. People with P.T.S.D., anxiety, depression, and autism benefit from a therapeutic relationship and alliance the horses help form and provide. There isn't a population we have crossed paths with yet, no age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, or socioeconomic class that does not benefit from the unique therapy these tiny horses provide within so many different settings.

creator.biography:
Hey Horse Lovers! If you love equestrian life, horse training, trail rides, auctions, and adventures then you found the right channel. My name is Shae and I own a little piece of heaven called Free Spirit Farm. My passion in life is working with horses from all different walks of life and revitalizing them through equine wellness, training, and care. I created this channel to spread awareness about what goes on not only as an equestrian farm owner, but also as a trainer, instructor, and entrepreneur. In my videos I try to be open and transparent about horse life both the good and the bad. I truly dedicate all of my time to my horses, training, riding program, and my farm. Take a look inside look at what I do by subscribing to my channel! As always, enjoy the ride!

Merch coming soon 🔥

creator.biography:
Welcome to A Life With Horses!
My name is Meryl Lynn, and my incredible Straight Egyptian Arabian mare, Pippa, is the heart and inspiration behind this channel. Whether you’re a horse enthusiast, new to horse ownership, or simply curious about the equestrian world, you’re in the right place!
Here’s what you’ll discover on this channel:
• Horse Basics Made Simple: Essential horse care and training tips for new horse owners. • Explore Equestrian Sports: Introductions to Endurance Riding, Dressage, Hunter/Jumper, and Western events. • Discover Horse Breeds: Unique traits and history of different breeds, including Pippa’s own rare and beautiful lineage.
Have questions about horse care, riding, or equestrian sports? Share them on the Community Page, and I’ll do my best to help!
Thanks for joining me—let’s celebrate and explore the incredible world of horses together!

creator.biography:
Saddle fitting & saddlery/tack tips, advice, and a look into the daily life of being a saddle fitter - by Poppy Webber - Society of Master Saddlers Qualified Saddle Fitter with many, many years of experience...

About Poppy: As well as being a full-time saddle fitter for her business PeeWee Saddlery, Poppy is also a wobbly upside-down yoga-er and a below average horse rider. She dreams of joining the circus. She is a monthly columnist for Absolute Horse Magazine, article writer, occasional university lecturer, talk giver, serial advice post writer, and social media obsessed... Poppy aims to bring a bit of sparkle (and a lot of smiles) into everyone's life. Some might say she's a comedy genius (they don't, she's the only one that says that!).

Don't forget to 'subscribe' & turn that little bell on. And PLEASE ask any questions you like.

creator.biography:
Welcome to the channel healing from depression. The purpose of these videos is to share with you the most up to date and effective strategies for treating depression and anxiety. As a depression survivor, I know this territory well and can assure you that there is a path to healing and recovery. There is a reason for hope.

As you watch these videos, you will encounter useful tools and resources that are designed to help you to feel better and to reduce your symptoms of anxiety and depression. Please feel free to contact me if you have any questions about the information you find. I wish you the best on your healing journey.

creator.biography:
Therapy Chat Podcast is hosted by Laura Reagan, LCSW-C, an integrative trauma psychotherapist, Clinical Supervisor, Consultant, Coach, Speaker and Trainer. 

Laura interviews therapists, authors and other experts about psychotherapy, trauma, attachment, mindfulness, perfectionism, worthiness, self-compassion, expressive arts and creativity.

Be a fly on the wall and listen to therapists discuss trauma focused psychotherapy techniques and self-care to prevent burnout, covering mindfulness, Brainspotting, EMDR, art therapy, and other integrative and somatic methods. They explore trauma, parenting, attachment, and the human experience of joy and suffering.

creator.biography: Monty Roberts (born May 14, 1935) is the American horse trainer who promotes his techniques of natural horsemanship through Join-Up® International, founded in 1997 and named after the core concept of his training method. Roberts believes that horses use a non-verbal language, which he terms "Equus," and that humans can use this gestural language to communicate with horses. In order to share his knowledge of horsemanship, Roberts has authored a number of books including an original best-seller, The Man Who Listens to Horses. Roberts also founded the Monty Roberts International Learning Center to teach his methods in Solvang, California, and an "online university" since 2009 to teach the concepts. See more of Monty's online videos at www.montyroberts.com

Visit our website at www.extension.umd.edu/agsploration.

creator.biography:
Welcome to Happy Hooves Equine Ltd!

We provide equine-assisted learning, therapeutic visits, and animal-assisted activities for children, young people, adults, schools, care homes, hospitals, and community groups.

Our miniature horses help create meaningful experiences that promote confidence, emotional wellbeing, communication, social skills, and connection. Through the unique bond between humans and horses, we support individuals of all ages and abilities, including those with additional needs such as autism, anxiety, and SEN.

On this channel, you’ll find behind-the-scenes moments from our herd, therapy and educational visits, horse care tips, success stories, special events, and a glimpse into the positive impact horses can have on people’s lives.

Whether you’re a horse lover, parent, educator, care provider, or simply interested in the power of animal-assisted activities, we invite you to follow our journey.

Don’t forget to subscribe and join the Happy Hooves family! ✨

creator.biography:
The UCF College of Medicine is the academic center of the emerging medical city at Lake Nona. The medical school enrolled its first class in 2009, and thanks to community donations, all 40 members of the charter class received full four-year scholarship, making UCF the first medical school in U.S. history to offer full scholarships to an entire class.

The college includes the M.D. program, which will ultimately enroll 480 students a year, and world-class researchers at the Burnett School of Biomedical Sciences. Together these programs create a research-intensive medical school where cutting-edge medical research spans the entire spectrum from laboratory bench to bedside.

Dedicated to being the nation’s premier 21st century medical school, the UCF College of Medicine features state-of-the-art labs and classrooms that support an innovative curriculum. Our program is designed to create physicians and scientists who will become health care leaders of tomorrow.

creator.biography:
Since 1977, Horse Illustrated has served the hands-on horse owner by promoting the best in horse management, riding and training for all breeds and styles of riding. Along with our website, HorseChannel.com, Horse Illustrated provides the latest horse news plus essential information about equine health, nutrition, grooming  and all aspects of horse care plus English and western training solutions, breed profiles and more. Horse Illustrated’s in-depth articles come from respected resources and top industry experts.

The editors of Horse Illustrated also produce Your New Horse, an annual reference guide that provides first-time and beginner horse owners with everything they need to know about caring for a horse. Horse Illustrated, Your New Horse and HorseChannel.com are part of the I-5 Publications stable of magazines and books. I-5 Publications is the leader in special interest pet magazines, trade magazines, books and websites dedicated to pet-loving consumers.

Equine Guelph, a not-for-profit Centre at the University of Guelph, serves the horse industry through education, research, and career support.

Equine Guelph is the leader in Online Studies for equine pursuits, boasting 20 accredited 12-week university level courses with highly-qualified instructors and expert guests. Plus, award-winning short courses that provide practical information and tips from equine industry and healthcare experts and feature the most up-to-date research and latest evidence-based resources. With these you can stay with your horses and balance your busy schedule.   

Explore our Free interactive tools to help you address a range of healthcare issues which may affect your horse(s). These free tools allow you to assess your own individual situation with practical recommendations you can take right to your barn.

A channel dedicated to improving the health and well-being of horses and providing evidence-based education for horse people.

candidates.summary: 频道简介自称是位于纽约Riverhead的马术设施，提供室内外马场、马厩与放牧区，属于马术运动与马匹护理机构。

creator.biography:
The North Fork’s premier equestrian facility, North Fork Equestrian is sited on over 21 acres of bucolic farmland, conveniently located in Riverhead, NY. This picturesque, world-class, equestrian complex is built to satisfy both the casual rider and Grand Prix athlete.

North Fork Equestrian features a 78'x185' indoor riding arena welcoming rider and horse with state of the art, travel right, dust free footing, surrounding mirrors, an insulated ceiling, and a stereo system throughout, 24 individual 12'x12' stalls, 2 indoor wash stalls with warm/cold water year-round, 2 outdoor wash stalls, 2 large boarder tack rooms, 25 grass turnout paddocks, and a 220'x160' outdoor ring with footing consisting of felt fibers and sand with ideal drainage and layout, allowing all year riding with the ultimate footing to satisfy any equestrian with a beautiful backdrop of landscaped trees.

creator.biography:
We are dedicated to helping educate horse owners and enthusiasts and we hope you find these videos interesting and helpful!
Since the founding of our original practice over 40 years ago, it has been our goal to bring not only high quality veterinary care to our community but also care with a personal connection. Compassion and expertise is what we look for in every doctor, technician, and staff member!
We are continually listening and watching for areas that are in need of equine veterinary care and as a result we currently have offices/coverage in the regions surrounding these areas of California:
Penryn, Sutter Creek, Penn Valley, Wilton, Napa Valley, Fortuna, Arcata, Brentwood, Gilroy, and Lake Forest just outside of Los Angeles! There are ~35 equine veterinarians within the group comprised of generalists & specialists in surgery, internal medicine, sports medicine, & critical care. All of our practices combined provide ambulatory veterinary care to a large portion of California.

Children's Rehabilitation Center is the premier pediatric outpatient facility. We strive to instill hope by promoting independence and self-esteem. Our passionate teams of experts take a family approach so that every child feels loved and inspired to reach their full potential. 

Located halfway between Cleveland and Pittsburgh in Warren, Ohio, Children's Rehabilitation Center serves the tri-county area (Trumbull, Mahoning and Columbiana counties) and beyond.

Families come to our Center seeking the very best care, along with excellence, compassion and professionalism. We share these same values and deliver!

Children's Rehabilitation Center is committed to empowering children to develop:

More confidence,
Determination, and
New skills to meet life's various challenges.

Welcome to RB Equestrian's YouTube Channel. 

Enjoy our videos full of tips, advice and new products for you and your horse.

Make sure you subscribe to keep up to date! 

Based just outside Milton Keynes, our equestrian superstore is a multi award winning tack shop and saddlery. Thanks to great training, and a love of all things horsey, we and our fantastic staff offer great service and help for all our visitors. 

We wanted to bring some of that to our YouTube channel so you too can share in our passion for horses.

Shop with us online at www.rbequestrian.co.uk

Visit our store: RB Equestrian, Unit 7 Lower Rectory Farm, Mill Lane, Great Brickhill, Milton Keynes, MK17 9FX

Call us on +44 (0)1908 365335

Email us at service@rbequestrian.co.uk

What you’ll find here:

Behind-the-scenes: Daily life on a working horse farm.
Healing Journeys: How horses help us develop resilience and mental wellness.
Evidence-Based Care: Challenging traditional horse-keeping to prioritize the horse's well-being.

Subscribe to see more!

creator.biography:
A Different Kind of Training Program for Horses
 
MANY riding horses suffer breakdowns, depression, sub-par performance, and overall ill health because of a poor relationship with their riders, an unsuitable environment, training program, or underlying physical issue.
Novellus Equestrian with Stacey Ericson is a unique equine training program that focuses on rebuilding healthy relationships between the horses and their riders using classic training methods for horses, and Equine Integrated Experience modules for the riders. Learn more about Equine Integrated Experience here.
Novellus Equestrian provides horses with an Individualized Training Program (ITP) to help them regain their confidence, restore their mental, emotional, and physical well-being, and to reconnect them with their human partners in a new way; one that provides understanding and harmony in the partnership through honoring each other.

candidates.name: Calderdale and Huddersfield NHS Foundation Trust
candidates.summary: 尚无可用的初筛理由，需补充公开资料。

creator.biography:
Calderdale and Huddersfield NHS Foundation Trust runs the two main hospitals in Huddersfield and Halifax – Huddersfield Royal Infirmary and Calderdale Royal Hospital - and provides outreach services in the local communities.

In 2015 more than 123,300 men, women and children were cared for as inpatients (stayed at least one night) or day cases and more than 438,300 people attended our outpatient clinics. Our A&E departments at both hospitals cared for more than 142,000 people. There were some 223,887 adult 
services and 64,108 children service contacts by our community teams.

Foundation trusts provide what the health service wants, yet are also free to invest quickly in the changes to the local community needs, in striving to be the best, and in putting their patients first.

creator.biography:
Hello, my name is Raquel and I am a curious person in love with life!
My personal mission has been to explore and experience new ways of living, thinking and feeling, to integrate these experiences into my life and share them, so that this inspiration I receive can also reach other people. I seek to discover alternatives, believing that we all have the power to consciously choose the life we want to have. And thus live a life more aligned with our essence, with purpose and with passion in what we believe in, whatever it is for each one of us.
I use experiences to know myself better and improve myself as a person. I'm amazed by the inner journey of self-discovery that emerges through these experiences.

On this channel I share my adventures and those of inspiring projects linked to sustainability and spirituality, which I have the privilege of visiting.

Thank you for following!

Raquel
🦋 Psychologist
🧘 Circles & Retreats
🎤 Speaker and Blogger
🌎 Travel with Purpose
🐾 House & Pet Sitter

creator.biography:
The Outdoor Therapy Centre for Research and Practice established to engage with therapeutic approaches that share common practices, such as place-based learning, embodied experiences, therapeutic adventure, and nature-based stress reduction.

​Our community is interested in revealing mental health practices that include nature and the outdoors as centre to the therapeutic process. This website is designed specifically for those interested in the field. We hope you find information about how outdoor therapies can bring the benefits of being outdoors into the counselling and therapy process. 

As a community of practice, we invite all those who are interested to collaborate with us on research projects and offering accessible training or consultation for outdoor therapy providers internationally. To find out more, we hope you look into becoming a Friend of the Centre.
